title: TC-SAW (Temperature Compensated SAW) - Band 28 (700 MHz) for WiFi 6E Coexistence Filter
subtitle: Design Validation and Performance Characterization
author: Dr. Elena Vasquez

sections.1_OBJECTIVE: This document describes the design, simulation, and characterization of a TC-SAW (Temperature Compensated SAW) filter targeting Band 28 (700 MHz) for WiFi 6E Coexistence Filter. The filter is designed on 36° YX LiTaO3 substrate with a target center frequency of 3542.5 MHz and bandwidth of 230.5 MHz. The objective is to validate that the filter meets the required insertion loss, rejection, and linearity specifications for integration into the WiFi 6E Coexistence Filter module. This design iteration addresses feedback from the previous revision regarding out-of-band rejection improvements and temperature stability.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Filter Type: TC-SAW (Temperature Compensated SAW)
- Frequency Band: Band 28 (700 MHz)
- Application: WiFi 6E Coexistence Filter
- Substrate: 36° YX LiTaO3
- Package: LGA (Land Grid Array)
- Design Tool: Keysight ADS 2024
- Design Center: Helsinki 5G Lab

This specification applies to all variants of the TC-SAW (Temperature Compensated SAW) design targeting Band 28 (700 MHz). Results are used to qualify the design for mass production release.
sections.3_DESIGN_PARAMETERS:
Center Frequency:       3542.5 MHz
Bandwidth (3 dB):       230.5 MHz
Insertion Loss Target:  <= 1.6 dB
Return Loss Target:     >= 11.0 dB
Out-of-Band Rejection:  >= 29.0 dB
Isolation (Duplexer):   >= 31.0 dB
Q Factor:               13918
Temperature Coefficient:-17.7 ppm/°C
Die Size:               2.7 x 1.7 mm
Wafer Size:             8-inch
Number of Resonators:   8
Electrode Material:     Al
Passivation:            Si3N4
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Open Keysight ADS 2024 and load the TC-SAW (Temperature Compensated SAW) template project.
2. Define the substrate stack: 36° YX LiTaO3 with specified layer thicknesses.
3. Set design targets: center freq 3542.5 MHz, BW 230.5 MHz.
4. Run initial EM simulation with 2D mesh density of 20 cells/wavelength.
5. Optimize resonator geometry using gradient descent (target IL < 1.6 dB).
6. Verify coupling coefficients between resonator stages.
7. Run 3D FEM simulation to account for package parasitics (LGA (Land Grid Array)).
8. Export GDS-II layout for mask fabrication.
9. Fabricate prototype wafers (8-inch, 36° YX LiTaO3).
10. Perform on-wafer probing using Anritsu MS46122B ShockLine.
11. Measure S-parameters (S11, S21, S12, S22) from 100 MHz to 10628 MHz.
12. Compare measured results against simulation and specification limits.
13. Perform temperature cycling (-40°C to +85°C) and re-measure.
14. Document results and generate summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Insertion loss at center frequency shall be <= 1.6 dB
- Return loss in passband shall be >= 11.0 dB
- Out-of-band rejection at +/- 346 MHz offset >= 29.0 dB
- Group delay variation across passband shall be <= 10 ns
- Temperature drift over -40°C to +85°C shall be <= 7.8 MHz
- Power handling shall be >= +30 dBm at 1 dB compression
- ESD tolerance >= 1000 V (HBM)
- Die yield on qualification lot >= 95%
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Measurement Date:       2024-03-21
Devices Tested:         78
Insertion Loss (meas):  1.26 dB
Return Loss (meas):     13.1 dB
Rejection (meas):       31.8 dB
Isolation (meas):       35.8 dB
Q Factor (meas):        13918
Group Delay Variation:  6.4 ns
Power Handling:         +30 dBm
Die Yield:              97.1%

Result Classification:  CONDITIONAL PASS
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The TC-SAW (Temperature Compensated SAW) design demonstrated acceptable performance for Band 28 (700 MHz).
b) Insertion loss met target specification.
c) Out-of-band rejection exceeded the minimum requirement.
d) Slight frequency drift observed at +85°C; TC layer thickness may need adjustment.
e) Cross-talk between adjacent filter channels was below -55 dB.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
1. Review near-band rejection margin for worst-case temperature.
2. Re-run EM simulation with refined mesh for better accuracy.
3. Schedule follow-up measurement after design tweak.
